title: Implement static deny-only kill-switch controls V1
businessObjective: Add one independent, repository-local Phase 1 safety boundary that can only deny and cannot authorize or execute an action.
technicalObjective: Implement the finite Kill-Switch Controls V1 design as a runtime-safe pure evaluator with private frozen committed authority, deterministic fail-closed decisions, focused validation, and no live control-plane behavior.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: V1 is a static Tier 0 deny-only safety contract; it has no mutable state, administrative endpoint, runtime service, external dependency, or production effect.
The private committed authority is internal to the evaluator, recursively frozen, independently self-checked, and cannot be supplied or replaced by an ordinary caller.
The exact validator command requires a separate bounded verifier-admission governance task before independent machine verification.
acceptanceCriteria: services/orchestrator/src/kill-switch/evaluator.mjs exports the normal one-argument evaluateKillSwitch(requestContext) interface and keeps the exact V1 authority private, recursively frozen, repository-committed, and independent of tests, scripts, mutable JSON imports, environment values, or caller-supplied schemas, contracts, authorities, dependencies, paths, or options.

The exact ordered V1 controls are global-autonomous-actions, playbook-content-schema-repair-shadow, executor-codex-content-executor, codex-dispatch, pending-actions, and outbound-notifications, with the identifiers, scopes, target actions, engaged states, and reason codes fixed by docs/orchestrator/P1-007_KILL_SWITCH_CONTROLS_V1_DESIGN.md.

Every public evaluation returns a newly allocated deeply frozen closed V1 object whose decision is deny; exact deterministic precedence covers internal-authority failure, malformed request, all six control matches, and valid no-match fail-closed outcomes, and no input can produce allow or throw.

The focused validator proves authority isolation, exact control and reason behavior, no-match denial, attempted caller authority/schema/dependency replacement, prior-decision mutation resistance, throwing proxies/getters, cyclic and malformed values, and valid deterministic deny decisions for every case without attempting exhaustive JSON Schema mutation.

The exact command node tests/orchestrator/validate-kill-switch-controls-v1.mjs runs explicitly in CI and passes with npm run verify:fast and git diff --check after a separate governance task admits that byte-for-byte command for independent machine verification.

No server, queue, scheduler, mutable switch store, Staff OS view, authorization grant, approval, executor, notification, deployment, rollback, audit backend, database, credential, network, guest-data, booking, payment, inventory, pricing, or production behavior is added.
requiredChecks: private frozen authority and dependency-direction inspection
malformed-input and caller-authority replacement regression validation
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses the exact evaluator, validator, design, CI, task-state, or evidence paths.

Any proposal adds mutable control state, runtime service behavior, caller-supplied authority, an allow outcome, external access, credentials, production writes, authorization, payments, booking, RLS, migrations, or workflow correctness.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the P1-007 evaluator, validator, design document, explicit CI step, task-state changes, and task evidence; preserve P1-004 through P1-006 authorities and evidence, canonical architecture sources, the immutable compatibility snapshot, and all external systems.
